Variance-Covariance analysis: Handout 1
Let's just clear the whole workspace and remove all the NAs:
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
d<-read.table("../data/SparrowSize.txt", header=TRUE)

dat <- d[which(!is.na(d$Tarsus) & !is.na(d$Wing) & !is.na(d$Sex) & !is.na(d$Cohort)), ]

d1 <- data.frame(dat$Tarsus, dat$Wing, dat$Sex)
pairs(d1, pch=19, cex=0.7)
cor.test(d1$Wing, d1$Tarsus)
```
